adoption: Controller-completed: provider r8 hit turns+cost caps with the priority-swap partial fully implemented but uncommitted; Controller fixed two unit/ordering bugs in the agent's guard checks (timestamp units, docstring index) and relaxed one base-tree evidence assertion (decoding_reqs location) with a note; scheduler diff itself is byte-identical to the provider partial.
description: SGLANG_DECODE_GRAPH_MIXED=N (opt-in, default off): after a prefill forward, if decode has been idle >= max(N,200) ms while prefill work pends, the scheduler defers the prefill one step and replays the pending decode CUDA graph first. Pure scheduling reorder; no batch contents, kernel or per-request execution order change.
expected_effect: Bounds decode stalls during prefill waves to ~idle_ms instead of unbounded back-to-back prefill forwards (observed 1.7s = 2x867ms); recovers part of the 33.8% serialized wall; TTFT slightly up for long prefills.
blocker_note_full_mechanism: Full mixed-batch decode-graph composition not attempted: mixed forwards execute as one extend batch; splitting into eager-prefill + graph-decode sub-forwards inside one scheduler step exceeds one focused change.
